description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractRegistrationService' implementing the 'RegistrationService' interface. It provides mechanisms to assert device registration status, retrieve device info, check gateway authorization, and generate registration assertions, mainly for use in device registration management within the Eclipse Hono project. The class handles registration validation, caching directives, and supports extendability for specific storage implementations.

classes.name: AbstractRegistrationService
classes.description: An abstract class providing registration assertion logic, device retrieval, and gateway authorization checking for device registration services.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Checks device registration status by retrieving device info asynchronously, then determines if the device is enabled, composing the result accordingly.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Checks device and gateway registration status asynchronously, verifying gateway authorization and device enabled status, and forming the appropriate registration result.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a gateway is authorized to act on behalf of a device based on the 'via' property in registration data.

methods.name: createSuccessfulRegistrationResult
methods.description: Creates a successful registration result with payload and cache directives.

methods.name: getAssertionPayload
methods.description: Generates the payload JSON object for registration assertion responses.

methods.name: isGatewaySupportedForDevice
methods.description: Determines if a gateway may act on behalf of a device based on registration info.

methods.name: isDeviceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the device registration data indicates the device is enabled.

methods.name: isDeviceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the registration result indicates the device is enabled.

methods.name: getRegistrationAssertionCacheDirective
methods.description: Returns the cache directive for registration assertions, defaulted to max age 300 seconds.

methods.name: getSupportedGatewaysForDevice
methods.description: Returns a JSON array of supported gateways based on registration info.
